institution: I Liceum Ogólnokształcące im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Gdańsk
detail: Attended Primary School No. 57 in Gdańsk (1964–1972) and graduated from the Nicolaus Copernicus I General Secondary School in Gdańsk in 1976.

institution: University of Gdańsk (Uniwersytet Gdański), Faculty of Humanities
detail: Studied history at the University of Gdańsk, graduating in 1980; his master's thesis dealt with the formation of the legend of Józef Piłsudski in pre-war periodicals. As a student he was involved in opposition activity, including the Student Solidarity Committee and the founding of the Independent Students' Association (NZS). The Sejm's records list his profession as historian.
